cirque.name: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
cirque.alt: Inside the red-and-white striped big top, painted in ink and gouache, under bunting and string lights, with a Ferris wheel in the park outside the open tent flap at the far left. High up a ringmistress cracks her whip as a little flower meadow bursts from the sawdust, a girl on one leg balances a strawberry parfait and a poodle hugs a black boot. On the red pedestal a strongman lifts a dewy rose gently, another lifts a baby elephant, a seal claps and a clown's teapot lid pops off on a drum. In the ring a clown zips by on a unicycle, a vet rushes to a seal, a clown's shopping bags burst and a blindfolded clown walks into a cream pie. At the ring's edge a clown springs out of a trapdoor, a little ghost makes the crowd jump up, a lion naps in a wooden boat, clowns climb aboard a red wagon and a troupe squeezes into a tiny striped car. A red-curtained arch with a clown sign on the left and a green-curtained arch on the right lead to other rooms, with curtained doorways on the balconies above; a striped ticket booth stands at the right.

cirque_guichet.name: Le guichet
cirque_guichet.alt: Close up at the red-and-gold ticket booth under its striped awning: in the left window a polka-dot clown hops, clutching his stubbed toe; in the middle a bee juggles three colored balls; on the right the ringmaster points at a juggler arriving with his clubs. In front, a man with a lantern walks behind a snail, a clown dressed as a cabbage stands between two plain clowns, and a man in an apron proudly holds up one cracker.

clowns.name: Les clowns
clowns.alt: The wild clowns' practice ring inside the big top, painted in ink and gouache under red-and-cream striped canvas, bunting and strings of little lights. At the back of a red-rimmed sawdust ring a man in a white toga juggles balls above a brass balance scale, a clown saws at his viola so hard his hat flies off, and another clown holds up a hoop. In the ring a seal raises its flipper to volunteer and three seals balance striped beach balls on their noses, while a girl in a blue dress waves a red flag and cheers. In front, a stern coach in a tracksuit blows his whistle as two trainees do press-ups, among a cheering crowd. On the left a red-velvet curtained doorway leads back to the big ring and a blue-curtained doorway leads to the careful clowns; on the right stands a big open costume trunk spilling scarves and wool.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the big ring

doors.label: Les clowns sages
doors.hint: Through the blue-curtained doorway to the careful clowns

zooms.label: la malle
zooms.hint: Look closer at the costume trunk

sages.name: Les clowns sages · Careful Clowns
sages.alt: The careful clowns' quiet ring inside the big top, painted in ink and gouache under blue-and-cream striped canvas and strings of little lights, a crowd of spectators on benches all round. On the left a blue-curtained doorway leads back to the wild clowns. At the back a puppy watches attentively from the door of a little striped tent and a grey elephant edges step by step along a low rope. In the middle a white swan carefully balances an egg on its head and a white-faced mime in black tiptoes silently, finger to lips. In front, a ringmaster in a red coat and top hat, a polka-dot clown, and an old clown with a cane strolling under a rainbow umbrella. Coiled ropes and a bench stand on the right.

doors.label: Les clowns
doors.hint: Back through the blue-curtained doorway to the wild clowns

clowns_malle.name: La malle
clowns_malle.alt: Close up of the big open red steamer trunk from the clowns' ring, lid up against the red-and-white striped tent wall, scarves and costumes tumbling out onto the sawdust, painted in ink and gouache. Everyone is spilling out of it: a curly-haired clown climbs over the rim reading a scroll only one line long, a frail old man sits inside lifting his teacup weakly in both hands, a neat man in an apron clips a poodle-shaped hedge, and a dad in a flat cap sits on the edge fishing patiently in a bucket with one goldfish. On the sawdust in front a calm man sits cross-legged, eyes closed, beside a bowl of perfectly still water, and a clown sits in the spilled scarves hugging a sleepy kitten tenderly. A coiled rope and a clown hat lie on the left, a costume on a stand and a stack of hat boxes on the right.

menagerie.name: La ménagerie
menagerie.alt: The circus menagerie, a straw-floored animal tent with red-and-white striped canvas and low wooden pens, painted in ink and gouache at eye level. At the back an elephant squeezes with difficulty through a little hoop held by a keeper, a monkey juggles plates terribly as they smash around him, and a vet with a black bag hurries to a giraffe with a bandaged neck. In front a clown in a patched coat searches with a lantern while the seal beside him wears his red nose, and a sea lion hugs a big jar of fizzy lemonade. On the right a painted wardrobe stands wide open with animals spilling out of it: a parrot with a candy jar on top, a sloth in a hammock, a cat by a goldfish bowl, a bee on a unicycle, a monkey and a little red toy train. On the left a red-curtained doorway leads back to the big ring, and below it a blue-and-white curtained doorway leads to the trainer's tent.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the big ring

doors.label: La tente du dresseur
doors.hint: Go through the blue-and-white curtained doorway to the trainer's tent

zooms.label: l'armoire
zooms.hint: Look closer at the animal wardrobe

dresseur.name: La tente du dresseur
dresseur.alt: The trainer's tent behind the menagerie, painted in ink and gouache under blue-and-white striped canvas with string lights, a red carpet running across the straw. A lion walks first along the red carpet, a bear bashes a big drum, a prince and his poodle sit side by side in a little ticket booth, and a sneezing lion makes the red curtains of his pen swing open. A huge hippo overflows a tiny bathtub, a keeper stands soaked beside a seal splashing in a tub, and a keeper with a name badge hands balloons to three penguins. Hay bales and a bucket stand on the right; the blue-curtained doorway on the left leads back to the menagerie.

doors.label: La ménagerie
doors.hint: Go back through the blue curtains to the menagerie

menagerie_armoire.name: L'armoire
menagerie_armoire.alt: Close up of the painted wooden wardrobe from the menagerie, standing open on the straw inside the red-and-white striped tent, painted in ink and gouache, with its animals spilling out. On top a parrot picks only the yellow candies out of a glass jar, inside a sloth sways ever so slightly in a little hammock, and a cat on the open drawer stares fixedly at a goldfish bowl. On the straw in front a sea lion holds up a fish cake with one candle made specially for him, a bee in a top hat rides a unicycle and a grinning monkey hops onto a little red express train chugging out of the wardrobe. A hay bale and a feed bucket stand on the left, animal crates and a lantern on the right.

trapezes.name: Les trapèzes
trapezes.alt: Looking up into the trapeze rig of the big top, red-and-white striped canvas criss-crossed with ropes, rope ladders and a safety net, painted in ink and gouache. High up a baker on a swing tosses buns, two baby elephants bounce in the strong net and a clown dives bravely toward a tub of custard. In mid-air a strongwoman holds a ladder firmly while an acrobat balances on top, a bear juggles on a unicycle along the tightrope, a clown tumbles as his stilts smash to pieces, a lion holds up a hoop impatiently and a swimmer glides along a water tank. On the sawdust a shy lion cub peeks from a red curtain, a poodle follows the ringmaster step for step, a jolly man arranges flowers, a man leaps madly in front of a painted garden folly, a dog sits loyally looking up, a man offers a girl a rose by a warm stove and a carpenter carves a wooden swan. The red-curtained doorway on the left leads back to the ring.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the ring

parade.name: La parade
parade.alt: A grand parade seen from the balcony of the big top, red-and-white striped canvas hung with bunting, painted in ink and gouache: one long line winds across the sawdust. At the back a snowman shivers dreadfully on a little float, a cat in a striped deli apron steadies a tower of eggs and the Snow Queen glares coldly from her sleigh at a little man. A trumpeter plays horribly out of tune while two seals cover their ears, a man waters a plant under a glass dome uselessly, a man pushes a huge boulder up a ramp, a clown hands a lost wallet back to a smiling lady and a gentleman tips his top hat. A rude man shoves another, an acrobat tests a trapeze with one toe and a hippo in a pink tutu tiptoes along a low tightrope. At the front a penguin sits solemnly beside a golden trophy, a ringmaster frowns at a monkey holding his top hat, a clown with half his wig gone looks in a mirror and a ringmaster measures a seal with a ruler. The red-curtained doorway on the left leads back to the ring.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the ring

magie.name: La magie
magie.alt: The magic show inside the big top, seen from the sawdust in front of a round wooden stage under purple-and-cream striped canvas, painted in ink and gouache. On stage: a lion whose fake mane slips to reveal a sheepish tabby cat, and a monkey in a lab coat measuring a trampoline with a measuring stick. On the sawdust: a clown tripping over his own big shoe on purpose, grinning and waving; a seal working through a wooden box of coloured balls, one after another; and an ant sweeping sawdust with a tiny broom. On the right, a magician in a top hat shows off an empty golden birdcage while secretly lifting a blue tablecloth, where a white dove hides in a hidden drawer. Three curtained doorways: red on the far left back to the ring, purple on the left to the volunteer corner, green on the far right to the collection corner.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the ring

doors.label: Le volontaire
doors.hint: Through the purple-curtained doorway to the volunteer corner

doors.label: La quête
doors.hint: Through the green-curtained doorway to the collection corner

volontaire.name: Le volontaire · The Volunteer
volontaire.alt: The volunteer corner of the magic tent, painted in ink and gouache under purple-and-cream striped canvas and strings of warm lights. On the left a purple-curtained doorway leads back to the magic show. On a low round stage a white rabbit hops of its own accord into a magician's top hat, a tabby cat grips a trapeze bar with wide-open eyes, and a ginger cat yawns wide open on a purple cushion. On the sawdust a faint dotted trail curves round a wooden post to a startled clown's nose, and three white poodles bow one after another, each in its own pool of spotlight. A star-painted folding screen, a spare top hat and a stool with a deck of cards stand on the right.

doors.label: La magie
doors.hint: Back through the purple-curtained doorway to the magic show

quete.name: La quête · The Collection
quete.alt: The collection corner of the circus tent, painted in ink and gouache under green-and-cream striped canvas and strings of warm lights. On the left a green-curtained doorway leads back to the magic show. On a long wooden stage-table a strongman, whistling, balances a grand piano on one fingertip beside a big jar of coins, a clown hands out free balloons and a giraffe leans in to take one, among a cheering crowd of clowns. In front, clowns tumble pell-mell out of a tiny red car, a clown slips on banana peels, and a pig drops a coin into a blue piggy bank beside little stacks of coins. A coat on a peg rail and folding chairs stand on the right.

doors.label: La magie
doors.hint: Back through the green-curtained doorway to the magic show

surprises.name: Les surprises
surprises.alt: A backstage practice ring inside the big top seen from high above, red-and-white striped canvas walls, lanterns and sawdust, painted in ink and gouache, where surprises go off everywhere at once. At the back a bear in a striped shirt juggles clubs with his sandwich flying among them, a baker carries a steaming loaf, a magician snaps his fingers as a dove vanishes in white mist, an elephant in a pink tutu blinks under a hanging lamp and a boy drives a toy train along parallel rails. In the middle three acrobats leap at the same moment, a cannon fires with a puff beside a clown clutching popcorn, a little audience dances a conga round two drums, a giant beet pops up and Sue jumps a mile, and a snowman serenades a dewy pear on his guitar. In front a pony squeezes between hay bales, a keeper rushes a bucket of fish to a hungry tiger, a tightrope walker on a low rope stares ahead, a confetti cannon goes off early over a startled clown and a cracked taped-up tent pole leans on an open umbrella. A red-curtained wooden doorway on the left leads back to the ring; a jack-in-the-box and a pile of gift boxes fill the right.

doors.label: Le Chapiteau du Cirque
doors.hint: Go back through the red-curtained doorway to the ring
